questionText: A triangle has two sides of length $8\text{ cm}$ and $11\text{ cm}$ with an included angle of $40°$. Find the area of the triangle, correct to one decimal place.
markingScheme:
Use area formula $A = \tfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C$ **(1 mark)**
Substitute: $A = \tfrac{1}{2}(8)(11)\sin 40°$ **(2 marks)**
Final answer $A \approx 28.3\text{ cm}^2$ **(2 marks)**

solutionSteps.explanation: When two sides and the included angle are known, use $A = \tfrac{1}{2}ab\sin C$.
